items.title: Proposed data center on land leased from LDS Church moves forward
items.summary: The Salt Lake Tribune reports that Cottle County, Texas, commissioners unanimously endorsed a special reinvestment zone covering 4,252 acres, much of it held by the church's Farmland Reserve subsidiary, and approved a tax abatement request from developer Aetheris for a proposed 96-megawatt data center. An AgReserve statement cited by the Tribune says Aetheris is independent and "not affiliated with Farmland Reserve or the church."
